title: Building separation Element Objectives
text: Development is to achieve the following Element Objectives: O 2.7.1 New development supports the desired future streetscape character with spaces between buildings. O 2.7.2 Building separation is in proportion to building height. O 2.7.3 Buildings are separated sufficiently to provide for residential amenity including visual and acoustic privacy, natural ventilation, sunlight and daylight access and outlook. O 2.7.4 Suitable areas are provided for communal and private open space, deep soil areas and landscaping between buildings.
notes: The intent says generic separation factors are 'defined by the Primary Development Parameters in Table 2.1'; they are in Table 2.7.
